notes: Fetched and inspected the PR head; no changes made. The requested single recomputation site does not exist in this checkout: HudBatch::new independently recomputes scaled dimensions at many call sites, using the GUI_SCALE atomic, and does not incorporate force_unicode. The vanilla-aware calculate_scale and gui_scaled_size in horizon-client-input/src/window.rs are not used by the game's HUD sizing. Consequently moving the hook to one existing recomputation site cannot satisfy the requested GUI-scale and Unicode contract; it requires a broader unification of GUI sizing and update timing first. No checks run and no branch pushed.
